test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A alone can complete (2)/(5) of a task in 12 days, while B alone can complete (3)/(4) of the same task in 25 days. In how many days can they complete the task if they work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A alone to complete (2)/(5) of work = 12 days

Time taken by B alone to complete (3)/(4) of work = 25 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A alone to complete (2)/(5) of work = (12 × 5/2) 

⇒ 30 days

Time taken by B alone to complete (3)/(4) of work = (25 × 4/3)

⇒ 100/3 days

LCM of 30 and 100/3 is 300

Efficiency of A = (300/30) = 10 units/day

Efficiency of B = (300/100/3) = (900/100)

⇒ 9 units/day

Now,

Time taken by both to complete the work together = [300/(10 + 9)] days

⇒ 300/19 days

**∴ The required time taken by both is (300)/(19) days.**
